description.value: Luxe Chinese Seafood Restaurant (名軒海鮮酒家) is a full-service Cantonese dining destination in Langley's Willowbrook area, built around the goal of replicating Hong Kong-style seafood and dim sum. The kitchen specializes in traditional Cantonese preparations, with dim sum served at lunch and an extensive seafood-focused dinner menu. Both dine-in and takeout options are available.

address.value: Unit 138A, 19653 Willowbrook Drive, Langley, BC V2Y 1A5
